patches.function: rear-view mirror placement (code after the jal at 0x0033EF70, RacePS2Base render path)
patches.purpose: mirror horizontal divisor: addiu t0,zero,640 -> lw t0,0x7F04(zero); the mirror is 260 x width / divisor frame pixels wide and centred, block value round(640 x R / (16/9)) for R > 16:9
menu frame buffer format: addiu a1,zero,1 -> lw a1,0x7F08(zero); func_001074D0 psm 1 (CT24) off, 2 (CT16, as the 480p Try pop-up) on
menu CRT row: daddu a2,zero,zero -> lw a2,0x7F0C(zero); row 0 (default row 1, 480i field) off, row 6 (480p, 640x448 frames) on
race psm for index 0: addiu a1,zero,1 -> lw a1,0x7F08(zero); with 0x00436708 the normal index requests exactly what the menus request, so a menu-race switch is no CRT change

patches.function: MOption.applyRaceDisplayMode (func_00436640), shared by index 0 and indexes above 2
patches.purpose: race CRT row: daddu a2,zero,zero -> lw a2,0x7F0C(zero); row 0 off, row 6 (480p) on
psm of the unknown-index path: addiu a1,zero,1 -> lw a1,0x7F08(zero); keeps that path equal to index 0
field halving of the window rectangle: lui at,0x3F00 (0.5) -> lw at,0x7F10(zero); 0.5 off (224-line field buffers), 1.0 on (448-line frames, viewport type 0 draws UI units 1:1)
field halving of the captured rectangle (when self+0x1D9C == 0): lui at,0x3F00 -> lw at,0x7F10(zero); 0.5 off, 1.0 on
viewport type of the draw back into the frame (func_004A2A10 argument, branch delay slot): addiu a0,zero,1 -> lw a0,0x7F14(zero); 1 (half-height field viewport) off, 0 (full frame) on

patches.function: race monitor state change (code after 0x003DA468, RaceMonitor area)
patches.purpose: psm of its 480i field request func_001074D0(state, 1, 1, 640, 448): addiu a1,zero,1 -> lw a1,0x7F08(zero)

patches.function: race monitor state change (code after 0x003DA468, RaceMonitor area)
patches.purpose: its explicit CRT row 1 (480i field): addiu a2,zero,1 -> lw a2,0x7F1C(zero); row 1 off, row 6 on (its row-2 request at 0x003DA4EC stays for step 2)
daddu s0,a1,zero -> lw s0,0x7F18(zero): the layout choice comes from the block word (0 field layout, the original path; 1 the 480p path); the original a1 is always 1 here and s0 only feeds the branch
mtc1 at,f0 -> addiu a2,zero,0x50: a2 = 0x50 for the 480p path (func_001063A8 ignores a2); f0 is not needed because 0x00106330 stores the 1.0f bits from at directly
addiu v1,zero,-1 -> addiu a3,zero,-1: width -1 (= 640) for the 480p path; func_001063A8 ignores a3
sw v1,48(s1) -> sw a3,48(s1): the same -1 stored to state+0x30
swc1 f0,20(s1) -> sw at,20(s1): the same 1.0f bits (0x3F800000) stored to state+0x14
beq s0,zero,0x00106360 -> bne s0,zero,0x00106360: the 480p path when the block word is 1
jal 0x00106710 -> jal 0x00106DA8: the 480p initialiser of the game (a0 = state from 0x00106310)
daddu a0,s1,zero -> addiu a1,zero,2 (delay slot): psm 2 (CT16); a0 already holds the state
addiu a1,zero,1 -> lw a1,0(s0): interlace from the state (s0 = 0x006184D0); 1 off, 0 on
addiu a3,zero,1 -> lw a3,8(s0): ffmd from the state; 1 both
addiu a2,zero,2 -> lw a2,4(s0): mode from the state; 2 off, 0x50 on
lui a0,0x0062 -> lw v0,0x7F18(zero): the boot layout word (v0 is dead here)
jal 0x001063A8 -> bne v0,zero,0x00100AD0: on, the mode 4 case (480p); its delay slot is the next row
addiu a0,a0,-31536 -> lui a0,0x0062 (delay slot; the mode 4 case sets a0 again)
beq zero,zero,0x00100B14 -> jal 0x001063A8: off, the original call
nop -> addiu a0,a0,-31536 (delay slot): a0 = 0x006184D0 as before
